testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.onboarding.continuous.ContinuousOnboardingFeatureTest

testcase.name: WHEN default browser step completed without RESULT_OK THEN pending stage is reset
WHEN sync primary button is clicked THEN navigateToSyncSignIn is invoked
WHEN default browser step completed with RESULT_OK THEN pending stage is reset
WHEN DAY_7 stage is completed THEN seventh day timestamp is saved
getNotificationOnboardingPageState returns the expected state
WHEN no notification button is clicked THEN no notification telemetry is recorded
WHEN sync primary button is clicked THEN sign-in telemetry is recorded
WHEN feature enabled and only second day completed THEN shouldShowContinuousOnboarding returns true
WHEN feature enabled and seventh day not completed THEN shouldShowContinuousOnboarding returns true
WHEN feature enabled and seventh day completed THEN shouldShowContinuousOnboarding returns false
WHEN default browser step completed without RESULT_OK THEN no set-to-default telemetry is recorded
WHEN notification impression event fires THEN notification card telemetry is recorded
WHEN notification secondary button is clicked THEN skip notification telemetry is recorded
WHEN notification primary button is clicked THEN turn on notification telemetry is recorded
WHEN NONE stage is completed THEN no timestamps are changed
WHEN sync impression event fires THEN sign-in card telemetry is recorded
WHEN feature enabled and only third day completed THEN shouldShowContinuousOnboarding returns true
WHEN DAY_3 stage is completed THEN third day timestamp is saved
WHEN DAY_2 stage is completed THEN second day timestamp is saved
WHEN default browser step completed with RESULT_OK THEN set-to-default telemetry is recorded
WHEN sync secondary button is clicked THEN skip sign-in telemetry is recorded
getSyncOnboardingPageState returns the expected state
WHEN no sync button is clicked THEN no sign-in telemetry is recorded
WHEN feature disabled THEN shouldShowContinuousOnboarding returns false
